scope: Targeted six-case temporal/update validation for the query-time as-of filter.
important_caveats: The implemented as-of filter is a session-level cutoff based on fact onset/session timestamps. It does not prove full event-valid-time temporal fidelity.

The six-case targeted result remained 4/6 primary-correct. f685340e improved versus the previous query-time-only rerun, while gpt4_2d58bcd6 failed despite relevant facts being present in retrieved context; this before/after delta is confounded by end-to-end LLM variance.
The evidence supports keeping the as-of filter as a safe temporal-fidelity improvement, but not claiming broader heldout parity.
